_about: The owner's answers of the QA loop's report (tools/report.py write --study qa-loop): one plain sentence or more per field. These are the items no file of a chain answers, the owner's own judgement; every other item is answered by code from the chain folder and the frozen PREREG.md (tools/qaloop_report.py) and is never written here. The loop's checkpoints steer the work and publish nothing, so these may stay empty until a result is to be published; an empty field is reported as missing, and a field that does not apply says so, starting with 'Not applicable:' and the reason. A session copies into a field only the owner's own words, as written, naming the owner's message in its pull request; no session writes a field in its own words, since the report would then be vouching for itself.
